title: Harden Tactus worker file tools
description:
The Tactus worker runtime exposed a whole-file write tool and stored runtime state inside the target checkout. A smoke run against Call Criteria proved this can destructively rewrite a tracked file and leave .kanbus runtime artifacts in the worker workspace.

Feature: Tactus worker safety

Scenario: Runtime state stays outside the target checkout
Given a Tactus worker run has an isolated target workspace
When Kanbus prepares worker runtime storage
Then the storage path is outside the target workspace
And no .kanbus runtime directory is created in the target checkout

Scenario: Existing files are changed through constrained edit tools
Given a generic Tactus worker receives a task that edits a tracked file
When the worker is given file modification tools
Then existing-file changes require exact append or replace operations
And the worker is not given a tool that can overwrite an existing file wholesale.
